label: 茶铺管理图标
prompt:
Create one independent production-ready 2D sprite for Chinese healing management game 茶园物语. Chinese ink and pale watercolor handpainting matching the supplied approved game assets. Clean broad quiet washes, thin warm grey/brown hand-drawn edges, very few material lines; no grain/no noisy dense texture/no muddy haze/no oversaturation/no harsh black outline/no glossy photographic material. Ivory, muted sage celadon, bamboo beige, warm pale wood brown, charcoal. Use parallel axonometric elevated camera, rectangular long ground edges slope up-right26degrees, short edges down-right30degrees, verticals stayvertical. No converging camera. True alpha transparent outside object, no checkerboard drawing, ground, shadow plate or glow. Complete isolated subject centered with transparent margins. No room, landscape, characters, baked labels, Chinese writing, numbers, watermarks, UI backplate or extra unrelated objects. Figma reference is only brush/palette and the requested object's design; never recreate whole screen. Refer to approved jar/table for controlled drawing and color. Formal sprite must be separable for Godot.
SUBJECT: ONE simplified traditional wooden ABACUS as teashop management entry icon. Front-facing flat rectangle, muted bamboo-brown frame with FIVE vertical thin rods and simple rounded dark brown beads, one horizontal divider, coarse simplified bead pattern readable at64px. Pale warm brown/ivory broad handpainted washes same palette as basket icon, very sparse texture. Single abacus symbol only; no coins, cups, person, desk, circular UI backplate, text, labels, numbers or decoration. Requested512squarecanvas with generous alpha margin, not a photoreal calculator.
